title: Human Gait Recognition Using Patch Distribution Feature and Locality-Constrained Group Sparse Representation
status: original_paper_reference_only; implementation parameters and proxy-video protocol are documented in config.json and README.md

dataset.name: USF HumanID
dataset.averaging: total correct / total probe videos (micro average)

gmm.initial_means_and_covariance: k-means clusters from all gallery patches
gmm.normalization: subtract per-vector scalar mean, then L2 normalize

classification.nn_distance: median over probe GEIs of minimum Euclidean distance to gallery GEIs
classification.rank5: If fewer than five groups are active, only active groups count as candidates
classification.parameter_selection: Paper reports best settings per probe and separately for Rank-1 and Rank-5; this is not a held-out validation result
